text: Energy balance , the net difference between energy intake and energy expenditure, has a profound effect on the capacity to build muscle. Molecular signaling is altered during shortterm energy deficits to favor catabolism over anabolism. Studies show that caloric restriction induces a decrease in both Akt phosphorylation and downregulation of mTOR signaling, with a corresponding activation of the FOXO family of transcription factors and upregulation of atrogin-1 and MuRF-1 expression (86, 105). Moreover, nutrient deprivation activates AMPK and NAD-dependent deacetylases, such as sirtuin 1, which in turn blunt mTOR phosphorylation (88).
